bullets: Private Markets: In a press release: Apollo to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 3, 2026.

M&A & Buyouts: Aviation services company AAR has agreed to acquire a 65% stake in Bain Capital-backed aircraft maintenance provider MRO Holdings for approximately $1.8bn, in a deal that will see the PE firm retain an interest in the business, according to a report by the Wall Street Journal.
Fed & Rates: Federal Reserve announced: Agencies publish resolution plan feedback letters for 15 banking organizations.

Investor Outlook: On Inside Blackstone, host Christine Anderson sits down with Relativity Space CEO & former Google CEO Eric Schmidt on the AI data center build-out, what he thinks about Silicon Valley’s timeline for superintelligence, what it takes to be an AI-native CEO.
Investor Outlook: Companies with significant family ownership generate roughly 70% of global economic output and 60% of the world’s jobs.
brief.marketRead: The S&P 500 stands at 7,683.69 (down 0.8% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 16.1, a normal-volatility reading. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 5.24% (up 7 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.37 pts (positively sloped). High-yield credit spreads are 3.02%, near long-run norms (up 9 bps on the prior reading). Bottom line: calm volatility and open credit markets are a supportive backdrop for dealmaking, fundraising and exits.
